### Item 1 — what the user expresses, simulator behaviour

- Target object: "borrow as much as I'm allowed on my Pocketwire Advance right now, sent to your regular bank debit card"; "Standard delivery to the card is fine; you do not want to pay extra for express"; card = "Oregon Pacific Credit Union debit card ending 5093".
- Timing: now (frozen 2026-09-24 14:05 EDT). Boundary: largest amount, standard delivery to an external debit card. Authorisation: "Borrowing is your own decision, so once the agent hands the advance request over to you, you submit it yourself exactly with the figures the agent gave you".
- The simulator is passive: never proposes an amount ("you want the most they can give you today"); conditional consent for account-side work: "If the agent says something on your account has to be sorted out before they can work out the advance, you tell them to go ahead and do whatever is needed on their side"; conditional June fact only if asked: "your employer switched payroll companies that month and the paycheck came in far later than usual; you do not know anything about fees". Identity: phone 5552653307 (volunteered), DOB 1988-11-19, SSN4 5286, email if wanted.
- Verification: `verify_customer_identity` with DOB + SSN4 only returns "Identity NOT verified … only 2 of the required 3 details matched"; with phone/email as a third detail it passes. The simulator supplies all of them on request, so reachable.

### Item 4 — scored parameters

**(a) Payroll-delay relief amount (on late fee 62c28762…).**
Computation note: "The relief is that late fee multiplied by the relief share, rounded to the cent (half up), and never more than the late fee itself"; relief share 0.10; base = latest-booked late fee = 3.00.
Factors found and the tier:
- Payroll delay length ("from the due date of the line's most recent advance to the date of the line's most recent autopay collection from a direct deposit"): due 2026-06-12 → collection 2026-06-30 = 18 days → "14 or more | 0.20".
- Direct deposit regularity (6 months, Standard requirement 800.00; higher test 12 deposits and 4800.00; lower 6 and 2400.00): 11 deposits, 12896.85 → "0.05 — fewer than 12 deposits, at least 6".
- Lateness record (12 months): 1 late fee, 3 advances → "1 | 3 or more | 0.05".
- Personal account age (wallet `opened_date '2022-03-08'`): 1661 days → "1095 days or more | 0.05".
- Plan membership (Pocketwire Onyx) → "Pocketwire Onyx | 0.05".
- Debit card relief treatment: active physical Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit, 13 purchases in 3-month window (≥10) → "0.02 added for each card purchase in the window" to the late fee × share before rounding.
Share = 0.10 + 0.20 + 0.05 + 0.05 + 0.05 + 0.05 = 0.50. Unrounded 3.00 × 0.50 = 1.50; + 13 × 0.02 = 0.26 → 1.76; half-up to the cent 1.76; ≤ 3.00. **Relief = 1.76.**

**(b) Largest advance (amount).**
Room sheet: "The room … is the tier's advance limit reduced by the remaining principal … The largest advance is the room rounded down to a whole multiple of the tier's advance increment." Standard: limit 200.00, increment 5.00.
- After the relief: principal disbursed 1100.00; fees booked 47.56; repayments and waivers 1147.56 + 1.76 = 1149.32; part left after fees 1101.76; remaining principal max(0, 1100.00 − 1101.76) = 0.00.
Factors:
- Borrowing record bonus (12 months): 3 advances → "2 or 3 | 10.00" → +10.00.
- Late fee holdback (12 months): late fees 3.00 less courtesy waivers booked in window 1.76 (the relief is a waiver "with the reason courtesy", booked today) = 1.24 → "Above zero and below 2.00 | 20.00" → −20.00.
- Line tenure (line opened 2023-05-02): 1241 days → "1095 days or more | 30.00" → +30.00.
- Plan room bonus (Onyx, Standard plan limit bonus 25.00) → +25.00.
- Recent payroll room bonus (1 month, Standard 800.00; higher 1600.00 from ≥2): 2250.80 from 2 → +50.00.
- Debit card room treatment ("acts on the room once the additions … and the deductions … have all been made"): Gold, 13 purchases → +13.00, then round down.
Room = 200.00 − 0.00 + 10.00 − 20.00 + 30.00 + 25.00 + 50.00 = 295.00; card treatment 308.00; rounded down to 5.00 → **305.00**. Bounds: ≥ 20.00 smallest advance, multiple of 5.00, count 1 ≤ 1 — "The largest advance worked out for the line takes the place of the effective limit as the ceiling on a new advance".

**(c) Flat advance fee on 305.00.** Pricing rules: 5.00 percent → 15.25; clamped to maximum 10.00; Pocketwire Onyx discount 10 percent → 10.00 − 1.00 = **9.00**. No express fee; standard delivery fee 0.00.

**(d) Due date.** "the tier's repayment term in calendar days after the disbursement date"; Standard 28 → 2026-09-24 + 28 = **2026-10-22**.

**Fall-back answers (computation documents only, no factor):** relief = 3.00 × 0.10 = 0.30; largest advance = 200.00 − 0.00 → 200.00 (fee 9.00 either way). Both definite and different from the answers above (1.76 / 305.00).

**Findability of each factor from record words:** late fee entry + `autopay_direct_deposit` repayment + due date → "payroll delay … autopay collection from a direct deposit" (doc_advance_payroll_delay_length); `wallet_direct_deposit` rows → "direct deposits into the linked Pocketwire Personal Account" (regularity relief, recent payroll room bonus); `late_fee` entries / count of `advance_disbursement` → lateness record, holdback, borrowing record; wallet `opened_date` → "Personal Account Age"; `variant_name 'Pocketwire Onyx'` → plan documents (grep "Onyx"); card `variant_name 'Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit'`, `card_form 'physical'`, `card_purchase` rows → "Pocketwire Visa Debit Card" documents; line `opened_date` → "Line Tenure". Every factor document names the product and the record kind it reads; none of them was reached only through a computation document's wording. No computation document announced a variation.

### Item 6 — problem tree derived from visible materials alone

Problems: P-root = work out and request the largest advance (customer's own write); P1 = payroll-delay relief on late fee 62c28762 (agent write). Direction: P-root waits on P1. Order: P1, then P-root.

Hop P-root → P1 — **state-derived**.
- Sentence (doc_advance_largest_advance_request, "Standing conditions"): "The largest advance a line can take is worked out only after every late fee on the line that qualifies for payroll-delay relief carries its relief waiver entry." It names a state ("carries its relief waiver entry"), not a tool or a procedure.
- Records: ledger has a `late_fee` entry (3.00) and no `advance_waiver`/waiver-reason entry at all.
- Search with the sentence's words "payroll-delay relief" → doc_advance_payroll_delay_relief, which defines which late fee qualifies ("whose autopay collection came from a direct deposit that posted after the advance's due date"), when ("once that advance is repaid in full"), how ("as a waiver of that one late fee with the reason courtesy, and without any request from the customer") and carries its own tool block. The records show the qualifying facts (item 3). The amount is from doc_advance_late_fee_relief_amount plus its factor documents.
- Combination: the state does not hold → write it with the relief tool → state holds → the largest advance can now be worked out.
No further hop: the relief document states no condition on anything else; the late fee itself is already booked and the advance is fully repaid.

**Two-way counter-proof.**
- Closest alternative ceilings: (i) the tier's advance limit 200.00 ("Advance limit — the maximum total advance principal outstanding on the line at one time, before any plan bonus", tier schedule column notes); (ii) the effective limit 225.00 (limit + plan limit bonus). Both are excluded by the largest-advance document: "The largest advance worked out for the line takes the place of the effective limit as the ceiling on a new advance", and by the retired clauses in doc_advance_outstanding_advances_and_monthly_count ("no longer decide how large a new advance can be"). Observation for the reveal: the tier-schedule column note still describes the advance limit as the maximum principal outstanding at one time and the plan limit bonus as "the amount added to the advance limit while … Prime, Onyx or Summit" — a competing reading that a careful reader resolves only through the more specific "takes the place of" sentence.
- Window boundaries: the three anniversary-day rows (2025-09-24 disbursement, 2026-03-24 tax-refund deposit, 2026-06-24 card purchase) are excluded by the explicit "dated after the same day of the month" wording; including them would give borrowing bonus 20.00, regularity 0.10 and 14 purchases.
- Base of the relief: "the late fee entry with the latest booking date" — only one late fee exists.
- Delivery/express: customer declines express; the request tool is always standard delivery to the external card.
- "Do only the one thing the customer asked for": requesting the advance without the relief leaves the largest advance "not yet worked out" under the standing condition; numerically, holdback would be 3.00 kept → 40.00 → room 275.00 → 288.00 → 285.00, a figure the visible rule forbids computing while the qualifying late fee lacks its relief waiver entry. Excluded by the prerequisite sentence (the source-form sentence, not a pre-solved route) plus the relief document's own rule and the records.
